note: The two 7ths sung from Do, each found a step under the high Do, with the octave asked too so the high Do stays in the ear; Do moves through six keys and the line about another key says what stays.

exercise.title: Sing the two 7ths and the octave
exercise.why: The high Do is the same note as Do, so you can always hear it, and each 7th is one small step down from there.

cells.text:
Press Start below to hear Do and start the mic. The leap to sing shows by name: m7 is the minor 7th, M7 the major 7th, P8 the octave.
Hear the high Do in your head first: the major 7th lands a half step under it, the minor 7th a whole step under it. Then sing that note on "oo" and hold it until Yes shows, and press Next below for another leap.
If a leap misses, press Restart below to hear Do again.
When Do moves to a new key, the notes are new but each 7th is still the same distance under the high Do.
